entries.note: HowTheyVote records the 25 Nov 2026 vote on the 2027 budget joint text (A10-0305/2026) as 406 for, 184 against, 69 abstentions, below 420, so the criterion is not met (EP news page confirms final approval; 2 sources read).

HowTheyVote records the 25 Nov 2026 final vote on the Czechia media freedom resolution (RC-B10-0508/2026) as 442 for, 158 against, 47 abstentions, at least 360, so the criterion is met (EP press room confirms adoption; 2 sources read).
